description: The published extension and mode contract.
licenseNote: AGPL-3.0-or-later is deliberate, not inherited. Extensions and modes import this package, which is what makes them combined works and what makes the decision in docs/design/08-triage.md §1.1 hold. Relicensing this package permissively 'to be friendly to extension authors' would quietly reverse that decision — see docs/design/07-tech-stack.md §10.
